_comment: Copy this to course_labels.json (which is gitignored) and edit.
Keys are case-insensitive substrings matched against the course name
Canvas returns; the first match wins, so order matters. Values are what
The point is to keep teacher surnames and period numbers -- i.e. the
student's full schedule -- out of the published data. Anything that does
not match a key falls back to the raw name with period markers stripped,
and scrape.py prints a warning listing it.
